title: Concept: Haskell Read instance applied to external text in haskell — review required
description: In haskell, read converts external text into a value. The derived Read parser accepts deeply nested input and the function is partial, so hostile input can crash the process or consume unbounded resources. Data from outside the program should go through a parser with size limits and a typed error channel.
applicability: haskell services that accept configuration or messages as text.
risk: Denial of service and unhandled parse failure; MEDIUM severity.
